mission.z4.0: The Deepwood watchtower keeps signalling 'ALL CLEAR' from a tower nobody is manning. Go and be nobody.
mission.z4.1: A deserter ranger left a very apologetic note and all of his arrows. Return one of these things.
mission.z4.2: Something is sitting the owlbear cubs. The cubs are fine. That is the worrying part.
mission.z4.3: The moss trolls have redecorated the trail markers. Now every path leads to the moss trolls.
mission.z4.4: Widow Hettle's 'dog' has followed you this far. Escort it home. It will escort you home.
mission.z4.5: Web Matron season. Walk the north path with a torch, a stick, and absolutely no screaming.
mission.z5.0: The Saltmere lighthouse has been signalling in what the harbourmaster calls 'sarcasm'. Investigate.
mission.z5.1: A smuggler's first mate wants to defect. He has a boat, a parrot, and eleven separate warrants.
mission.z5.2: The gulls have organised. They have a spokesbird. Do not agree to anything the spokesbird says.
mission.z5.3: Count the barrels on the east dock. The manifest says nine. There are always eleven. Find out why.
mission.z5.4: The tide brought back a crate the town threw out in spring. Politely throw it out again.
mission.z5.5: Something in the shallows keeps returning lost boots. Only left ones. Thank it and stop it.
mission.z6.0: Sunscorch's only well now answers questions. Nobody likes the answers. Cap it.
mission.z6.1: The Sheriff of Nowhere has deputised a cactus. Serve the cactus its paperwork.
mission.z6.2: A mirage has been selling shade. Customers report the shade is excellent and also not there.
mission.z6.3: The mesa road's signposts have been turned to face each other. They seem happy. Turn them back.
mission.z6.4: Vultures are circling a man who is emphatically fine. Escort him out from under the omen.
mission.z6.5: Dust devils keep stealing hats. There is a hill of hats. Reclaim what you can carry.
mission.z7.0: The Ashen Reach's monuments have started keeping score. Find out what game, and who is winning.
mission.z7.1: A standard-bearer is still holding the line for an army that went home a century ago. Bring a chair.
mission.z7.2: Grief wraiths gather where somebody sighs. Walk the ridge in a good mood. That is the whole job.
mission.z7.3: Blackglass keeps growing back across the pass. Clear it. It will not thank you.
mission.z7.4: Somebody left flowers on every cairn in the Reach. There are four thousand cairns. Find the somebody.
mission.z7.5: The ash falls upward on the east slope. The scholars want a jar of it and no further questions.
mission.z8.0: Cinderpeak's fire cultists have booked the caldera for a solstice they invented. Un-book it.
mission.z8.1: A magma whelp has imprinted on a blacksmith. The blacksmith is thrilled. The guild is not.
mission.z8.2: The kiln-marshal's war drums keep the whole mountain awake. Negotiate, or confiscate the drums.
mission.z8.3: Obsidian sentries have started saluting each other. Nobody gave that order. Find who did.
mission.z8.4: Retrieve the smelter's tongs from inside the smelter. Bring the long tongs. Bring longer tongs.
mission.z8.5: Smoke shades are re-enacting last year's eruption nightly. Reviews are strong. Ask them to stop.
mission.z9.0: Frostveil's summit citadel has a doorbell now. Ring it. Report what answers.
mission.z9.1: The glacier moved four feet overnight and took a shepherd's entire fence with it. Negotiate its return.
mission.z9.2: Something up here is building snowmen facing the pass. There are two hundred. Count them again tomorrow.
mission.z9.3: The frozen bell tower rang once, last week, in no wind at all. Wait there until it does it again.
mission.z9.4: A climber's flag is planted on a peak nobody has climbed. Verify. Do not be impressed.
mission.z9.5: Ice keeps forming in the shape of a door on the north face. Do not open it. Measure it.
mission.z10.0: Duskgate's violet light makes every shadow point the wrong way. Map three streets before it gets clever.
mission.z10.1: The pale citadel's gate is unlocked. It has never been unlocked. Close it and say nothing.
mission.z10.2: A herald keeps announcing arrivals that have not happened yet. Attend one. Arrive early.
mission.z10.3: The ruins here echo before you speak. Have a short conversation and take excellent notes.
mission.z10.4: Someone is still lighting the lamps in Duskgate every evening. Find them. Thank them properly.
mission.z10.5: The dusk does not move. It has not moved in a year. Stand in it for an hour and report.
patrol.tick.10: You escorted a lost duckling to water. It escorted itself back. Twice.
patrol.tick.11: A drunk poet recited nine verses at you. You survived seven.
patrol.tick.12: You found the mayor's stolen portrait. It was behind the mayor.
patrol.tick.13: Someone chalked 'THE WATCH SLEEPS' on the barracks. You added 'IN SHIFTS'.
patrol.tick.14: You tested every door on Cooper Street. One tested back.
patrol.tick.15: A cat led you three streets to show you a second, larger cat.
patrol.tick.16: You broke up an argument about whose turn it was to argue.
patrol.tick.17: The bell rang the wrong hour. You let it have this one.
patrol.tick.18: You helped a locksmith who had locked himself out. He asked for discretion.
patrol.tick.19: Nothing happened for thirty minutes. You wrote it down beautifully.
arena.win.0: Clean. The crowd is already arguing about whether they saw it.
arena.win.1: You won the fight and the argument that started it.
arena.win.2: Textbook. Somebody should write the textbook.
arena.win.3: They tapped out somewhere around the second decision you made.
arena.win.4: The sand is barely disturbed. The reputation is thoroughly disturbed.
arena.win.5: A bookmaker in the third row has gone very quiet.
arena.win.6: You are asked for your name. You give it. It is written down carefully.
arena.win.7: The Watch is going to hear about this before you get home.
arena.win.8: That one goes in the ballad. The bard is already improvising badly.
arena.win.9: You offered a hand up. It was accepted, eventually.
arena.win.10: Nobody in the stands is sitting down. That is the whole review.
arena.win.11: A child in the front row has decided what to be when they grow up.
arena.win.12: You made it look easy, which is the most annoying way to win.
arena.win.13: The Master of Ceremonies mispronounces your name triumphantly.
arena.win.14: Won on points, style, and one absolutely unnecessary flourish.
arena.lose.0: You'll get them next time. Possibly the time after.
arena.lose.1: A tactical retreat, performed at considerable speed.
arena.lose.2: The sand broke your fall. The fall broke your streak.
arena.lose.3: Somewhere, a bard is already rewriting the lyrics.
arena.lose.4: Your opponent sends their regards, and a get-well basket.
arena.lose.5: Comprehensive. You will have opinions about it later.
arena.lose.6: Beaten fairly, which is the irritating kind.
arena.lose.7: You had a plan. The plan had opinions of its own.
arena.lose.8: A bookmaker in the third row is delighted.
arena.lose.9: You get up. Slowly, but you get up, and the crowd notes it.
arena.lose.10: That is going to be sore tomorrow, and philosophical by Thursday.
arena.lose.11: You learned three things. Two of them hurt.
arena.lose.12: Outfought. Not outlasted — you were still standing at the end of it.
arena.lose.13: The crowd goes quiet, then generous. They have all been here.
arena.lose.14: You lost the fight. You did not lose the room.
tips.label: Tip:
tips.0: Vigor is the whole game. Spend it every day; it does not save up for you.
tips.1: Once your vigor is gone, put the Watch to work — patrol banks gold and XP while you are away.
tips.2: Patrol holds eight hours of takings, then stops earning. It banks itself at midnight regardless.
tips.3: Attributes are the bottomless sink. Gold you are not spending is gold not working.
tips.4: A mission's reward scales with its zone, not with how long it takes. Take the frontier when you can survive it.
tips.5: Rerolling the board is cheap early and pointless late. Rely on it while it is cheap.
tips.6: Set pieces beat better numbers. Two of a set is already worth wearing.
tips.7: Dismantle what you will never wear; the Forge eats scraps and dust, and the vendor pays pennies.
tips.8: The wheel's first spin each day is free. There is no reason on earth to skip it.
tips.9: Arena offers refresh on their own. Losing costs you nothing but pride and a little honor.
tips.10: Fight opponents above you. The ladder only moves when you reach.
tips.11: Dungeon floors do not reset. A wall you bounced off today is a wall you can plan for.
tips.12: Expeditions want a rested hero and a full backpack slot. Check both before you embark.
tips.13: Feed one pet properly rather than four pets a little. The aura scales with level.
tips.14: Every pet you own helps, even the ones in the back. The collection bonus counts heads.
tips.15: A mount pays for itself in mission time. Buy the next one the day you can afford it.
tips.16: Gems are earned, never sold. Anyone who tells you otherwise is in the wrong game.
tips.17: The Well posts its odds and its pity counter before you spend. Read them; they are honest.
tips.18: Dailies are small and weeklies are not. Do the weeklies first when time is short.
tips.19: The calendar pays whether you play well or not. Open it once a day.
tips.20: Elixirs run on real hours. Drink one at the start of a session, not the end.
tips.21: The Codex pays a permanent bonus for monsters you have already killed. It fills itself.
tips.22: Eight legendaries have names. They turn up where legendaries turn up, and never twice.
tips.23: Keep a backpack slot free. A full bag turns a good drop into loose change.
tips.24: There is no rush. This is a game about tomorrow, and tomorrow always comes.
miniboss.the-tidewright.name: The Tidewright
miniboss.the-tidewright.intro: I build what the sea asks for. Lately it has been asking for a door.
miniboss.gallery-attendant-nine.name: Gallery Attendant Nine
miniboss.gallery-attendant-nine.intro: Attendants One through Eight are also here. Somewhere. Behind you, mostly.
miniboss.the-relief-watch.name: The Relief Watch
miniboss.the-relief-watch.intro: I came to relieve the last watchman. That was some time ago. Nobody came to relieve me.
miniboss.great-aunt-pinewatch.name: Great-Aunt Pinewatch
miniboss.great-aunt-pinewatch.intro: You will have something to eat, you will sit down, and you will lose.
miniboss.the-second-lantern.name: The Second Lantern
miniboss.the-second-lantern.intro: There has only ever been one lantern here. I am the other one.
miniboss.quartermaster-nobody.name: Quartermaster Nobody
miniboss.quartermaster-nobody.intro: Everything unclaimed is mine. You look thoroughly unclaimed.
